4f5610ca9725eb040a390db80364b5aac0606bb9.headline: DOJ defends Trump’s White House media ban: access is a “privilege,” not a right
4f5610ca9725eb040a390db80364b5aac0606bb9.summary: The Justice Department told a federal judge that President Trump can bar CNN, MS NOW, and Politico from White House grounds, casting hard-pass access as a privilege tied to national security and professional conduct. Court papers cite alleged disclosures about East Wing security work, a leak probe, and ballroom funding details. A hearing is set for Wednesday as the outlets argue the ban violates the First Amendment.

7f626649abfd3c5493487b0cec668153d9078111.headline: ICE’s “Operation Rotten Apple” nets more than 2,000 arrests across New York
7f626649abfd3c5493487b0cec668153d9078111.summary: Federal immigration officers reported more than 2,000 arrests statewide in a New York crackdown officials branded Operation Rotten Apple, highlighting child rapists, murderers, and other serious offenders among those taken into custody. DHS leaders framed the sweep as overdue enforcement against criminal noncitizens. Local critics and later reporting stressed that many citywide arrestees lacked prior criminal records, keeping the assimilation and sanctuary debate hot through September.

b9f9effdde32475829c0ab561f9014572c49b8d2.headline: Matt Walsh: diesel spiral and Ukraine refinery strikes could fuel a deeper energy crisis
b9f9effdde32475829c0ab561f9014572c49b8d2.summary: In a September 21 essay tied to his show, Matt Walsh argues that conventional “Iran war = high gas” framing understates a diesel and refining shock as Ukraine hits Russian fuel infrastructure. He relays a former White House official’s hard-line warning and calls for an immediate end to U.S. tolerance of those strikes. A follow-up episode on September 22 also highlighted alleged PPP-loan funding linked to the Haitian president’s assassination.

70ea97b5ea1a8fb0610456036462eae312ab2e4e.headline: Erika Kirk faces online pile-on after fishing-trip photos shared after Charlie’s anniversary
70ea97b5ea1a8fb0610456036462eae312ab2e4e.summary: On September 23, Erika Kirk drew fresh X criticism over Instagram photos from a mountain fishing trip she described as a place Charlie had wanted to visit with their children. A political account questioned the identity of people pictured without providing evidence. The flare-up lands weeks after polarized reactions to her “until Heaven” anniversary tribute and continued scrutiny of her leadership of Turning Point USA.

50f97527f3280ed0abe86c6ea53e245a3ef8ef04.headline: Elon Musk calls Xi a “great leader” and praises Tesla’s Shanghai Gigafactory on Chinese state TV
50f97527f3280ed0abe86c6ea53e245a3ef8ef04.summary: In a September 23 interview with Chinese state broadcaster CCTV, Elon Musk praised President Xi Jinping as a great leader and highlighted China’s infrastructure buildout and rising living standards. He called Tesla’s Shanghai plant a “gem” and credited local talent for its success. Musk also encouraged travelers to visit Beijing, Shanghai, and Xi’an — comments sure to ripple through U.S. politics and tech circles.

81104d8861cf94c4a9d210c4e00f274552b2e569.headline: xAI launches Grok 4.7 for coding, agents, and knowledge work — now in GitHub Copilot
81104d8861cf94c4a9d210c4e00f274552b2e569.summary: xAI introduced Grok 4.7 around September 21 as a longer-horizon model aimed at coding, agent workflows, and serious knowledge work. The company posted pricing and availability across the xAI API, Grok Build, and Cursor, with GitHub confirming Copilot access the same week. This is capability news — not hustle-funnel spam — and fits genuine AI tooling interest.

a6a1c769ad206ea8ac84b34fb98b2510edb4b290.headline: iPhone Duo countdown: 15 features to know before October pre-orders
a6a1c769ad206ea8ac84b34fb98b2510edb4b290.summary: Apple’s first foldable iPhone Duo is racing toward October 16 pre-orders and an October 23 launch after the September 9 “Surprise and Shine” event. MacRumors rounds up hinge design, dual displays, A20 Pro silicon, dual-battery behavior, IP68 sealing, and the $1,999 starting price. Separately, Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12 with the new Health Sensing System began shipping September 18.

c6c0ec5dc6b42fdc55ea9fdbeb2262dc5a8f0cd5.headline: LEGO Ideas Downton Abbey: 4,711-piece Highclere Castle set arrives in October
c6c0ec5dc6b42fdc55ea9fdbeb2262dc5a8f0cd5.summary: On September 10 the LEGO Group unveiled LEGO Ideas Downton Abbey (21373), a 4,711-piece adult set recreating Highclere Castle with upstairs and downstairs rooms and 13 minifigures. Insiders early access begins October 1, with general release October 4 at $349.99. It headlines a busy September slate that already brought Bikini Bottom, the Enterprise bridge, and Batman Returns Batmobile to shelves.

6d55e4dc3590aa4c7434be4ce518f41cef64a8a8.headline: Canon EOS R8 Mark II: lightweight full-frame with stronger IBIS and film-tone looks
6d55e4dc3590aa4c7434be4ce518f41cef64a8a8.summary: Canon’s mid-September launch of the EOS R8 Mark II targets travelers and creators who want full-frame quality without bulk. The 24.2MP body adds improved 5-axis in-body stabilization plus NegativeFilmtone and PositiveFilmtone color profiles aimed at stills and video storytelling. New EOS R-system accessories round out the announcement for photographers stepping up from APS-C or older RF bodies.

e8728dafc9ef42b62fc460417f05efa0ecc0855b.headline: Insta360 Luna Pro goes global: Leica-tuned gimbal camera with 8K and 4K vertical video
e8728dafc9ef42b62fc460417f05efa0ecc0855b.summary: Insta360’s Luna Pro, co-engineered with Leica, expanded to global markets in September with a 1-inch sensor, 8K capture, and strong overlap with the higher-end Luna Ultra feature set. PetaPixel notes 4K vertical video aimed at everyday vlogging and social workflows. A companion firmware update for Luna Ultra also added Stage Mode and deeper in-camera zoom for live performances.

4a7ed0ac79e76feb9de2c938c25581268305016f.headline: Harley-Davidson and Realtree drop second limited-edition camo apparel collection
4a7ed0ac79e76feb9de2c938c25581268305016f.summary: On September 16 Harley-Davidson and Realtree released their second limited collaboration of apparel and accessories built for riders who also live outdoors. The drop expands into cargo pants, reversible vests, work shirts, hoodies, and caps using Realtree APG patterns with H-D branding. Pieces are available now at h-d.com/realtree and participating U.S. dealerships.

4e351a7cffe6a1e21731c0937be201caca32a36d.headline: 2027 Jeep Wrangler JL-2A: retro tribute to the original Willys CJ-2A
4e351a7cffe6a1e21731c0937be201caca32a36d.summary: Jeep’s September reveal of the Wrangler JL-2A — part of the Twelve 4 Twelve special-edition run — tips its hat to the 1945 Willys CJ-2A with retro styling on a Rubicon foundation. Orders are expected to open in October for a limited run aimed at heritage buyers. Separately, Jeep and Harley-Davidson kept their European community partnership visible at Bike Week earlier this month.

56a188d871ef3e10e53a57ddf011c72500c580b1.headline: GM technical bulletin targets valvetrain tick: rocker arms and lash adjusters under scrutiny
56a188d871ef3e10e53a57ddf011c72500c580b1.summary: General Motors’ PIP6101-series bulletins address a top-end ticking noise on recent Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, and GMC models, tracing it to debris affecting hydraulic valve lash adjusters. Dealers may inspect and replace all 16 rocker arms and adjusters when defects are found — a service fix, not a formal recall with owner mailings. For owners chasing a persistent “keep ticking” sound, this remains the live shop guidance in 2026.

cd48006473a9cb3147981dde2577d2e218959ab6.headline: Five Finger Death Punch drops “Legacy” music video as physical albums hit shelves
cd48006473a9cb3147981dde2577d2e218959ab6.summary: Five Finger Death Punch premiered the official video for the title track of their album Legacy in mid-September as physical editions arrived in stores. The clip keeps the band’s arena-metal punch front and center for longtime fans of 2000s hard rock and modern metal radio. Coverage from Blabbermouth and rock outlets framed the release as a full-cycle album moment, not just a streaming single drop.

2a88c2a0701ed6aea7e0e91e8efa512eb107c72a.headline: Jets reshuffle roster: Onyemata to IR, Reeder and others elevated after Packers loss
2a88c2a0701ed6aea7e0e91e8efa512eb107c72a.summary: On September 22 the Jets executed a wave of roster moves, placing David Onyemata, Arian Smith, and Marcelino McCrary-Ball on injured reserve while elevating Troy Reeder and others to the active roster. Practice-squad additions included Will Levis among several new names as the team digests an overtime loss to Green Bay. Coach Aaron Glenn continues to stress defensive yardage strength while looking ahead to Detroit.

e2a63fc3fdc76961a27aa83ac6bc7410bf80a3b1.headline: Penguins’ center depth already tested as Kindel and Lizotte deal with injuries
e2a63fc3fdc76961a27aa83ac6bc7410bf80a3b1.summary: Pittsburgh’s preseason opened with a 4–1 win over Buffalo and a 7–4 loss to Detroit, but the bigger story is early injury noise down the middle. TribLive reports Ben Kindel and Blake Lizotte issues already stressing center depth, with additional day-to-day tags on Brazeau and Koivunen. Fans tracking the Penguins’ runway into the regular season will want every update from camp medicals.

e481ff19f4eb3139072ca507fcb8cc387e27bd67.headline: Connecticut Renaissance Faire heads into Faerie Ring Revels weekend (Sept 26–27)
e481ff19f4eb3139072ca507fcb8cc387e27bd67.summary: The Connecticut Renaissance Faire in Lebanon continues its 2026 season with Faerie Ring Revels on September 26–27, featuring fairy and flora costume contests after Shirefolk Weekend. The faire runs on select weekends through late October. For anyone mapping a New England autumn outing with jousts, crafts, and themed weekends, this is the near-term date to circle.

f0c3da000241fb7c903f09cc74344aa1cad96961.headline: Adirondacks travel pitch: peak foliage paired with family adventure
f0c3da000241fb7c903f09cc74344aa1cad96961.summary: As September tips into foliage season, the Adirondacks are getting fresh national travel ink for combining early color with family-friendly outdoor itineraries. Guides emphasize shoulder-season pacing — cooler hikes, lake towns, and fewer midsummer crowds than peak July. Elsewhere, fall destination marketing is pushing Smokies and Great Lakes alternatives alongside classic New England leaf-peeping.

6975ad191d5193a5b736715f9800be6f38a46fd2.headline: Westport Volunteer EMS recruiting for EMT course — life-saving skills for Fairfield County
6975ad191d5193a5b736715f9800be6f38a46fd2.summary: Westport Volunteer EMS continues its long local tradition of training community EMTs, with coursework covering bandaging, childbirth, and multi-system trauma under veteran instructors. Officials say seats fill quickly with adults from across Fairfield County who want to volunteer. The squad’s mix of paid staff, volunteers, and Norwalk Hospital paramedic backup underpins 24/7 coverage for the town.

7b5dabe2899a0b12cb00d51c8ec369b244c6ae50.headline: Karen Woodall clarifies unauthorized article and distances work from PASG framing
7b5dabe2899a0b12cb00d51c8ec369b244c6ae50.summary: On September 11 expert Karen Woodall publicly clarified that an article bearing her name and photo appeared in Contemporary Family Quarterly without her submission or permission. She notes she left the Parental Alienation Study Group in 2019 and no longer uses classic parental-alienation diagnostic frameworks, focusing instead on children’s attachment adaptations and coerced alignment. Her book The Journey of the Alienated Child is slated for Routledge this autumn.

2106dcafb616e01d604092e5325f7d244b0b8e48.headline: Trumbull police: Bridgeport man charged with attempted murder after domestic assault
2106dcafb616e01d604092e5325f7d244b0b8e48.summary: Trumbull police say 53-year-old Ronald Champlin of Bridgeport was arrested Tuesday after a 911 call from a woman screaming for help. Officers found her seriously injured at a home on Palomino Pass and took Champlin into custody at the scene. Investigators say he threatened and assaulted her for about two days; he faces attempted-murder and domestic-violence charges and was held on a $2 million bond ahead of Wednesday’s arraignment in Bridgeport.

062d8c3b39d8b676809d3fdc8f74d3c0e4a5a2a2.headline: Trumbull could host one of CT’s first AI data centers despite new moratorium
062d8c3b39d8b676809d3fdc8f74d3c0e4a5a2a2.summary: A decades-old data center at 80 Merritt Blvd. in Trumbull is being evaluated for a high-density, AI-ready upgrade even after the Town Council passed a two-year moratorium on new data centers. The pause covers new facilities, not upgrades to the existing ~15-megawatt site. First Selectman Vicki Tesoro says operators agreed to hold electrical draw, noise, water use, and building footprint flat, while residents still warn about grid strain and want stronger enforceable limits.

67b0ab80760fc42a155057fd1b58f2b24d91aeeb.headline: Seven Trumbull students named National Merit Scholarship semifinalists
67b0ab80760fc42a155057fd1b58f2b24d91aeeb.summary: The National Merit Scholarship Corporation named more than 16,000 semifinalists in its 72nd annual program, including seven from Trumbull. St. Joseph High’s Paul Mountcastle and Trumbull High students Maura Brunt, Jenny Hua, Neel Jakka, Jude Maltas, Tate Sullivan, and Hudson Zentz made the cut from more than 1.2 million PSAT entrants. Finalist decisions come next February, with scholarships announced through spring and summer 2027.

728bbee10ddb2013aad68c31d3bb61cf41abe8d1.headline: Apple unveils iPhone Duo: foldable design, A20 Pro, October 16 pre-orders
728bbee10ddb2013aad68c31d3bb61cf41abe8d1.summary: Apple’s newsroom confirms iPhone Duo, the first foldable iPhone, with a 7.6-inch inner display, 5.4-inch outer display, A20 Pro silicon, dual-battery design, and IP68 sealing. Pre-orders begin October 16 with availability October 23, starting at $1,999. iOS 27 adapts Split View multitasking and fold-aware camera features for the new form factor.

d8deec9fd39b9823708283a533d6190e4f8c7dd2.headline: Jeep introduces 2027 Wrangler JL-2A: civilian-legend tribute in Twelve 4 Twelve series
d8deec9fd39b9823708283a533d6190e4f8c7dd2.summary: Jeep’s free press release unveils the 2027 Wrangler JL-2A, the latest Twelve 4 Twelve special edition inspired by the original Willys CJ-2A. Built on a Rubicon foundation with heritage styling cues, Joose wheels, and TrailCam, the JL-2A package is priced around $4,995 over a similarly equipped Rubicon. Orders are slated to open in October for a limited run aimed at heritage buyers.

10c631125e29b635579fb12a76ab1bcf80c2743c.headline: Penguins list Ben Kindel day-to-day with lower-body injury after shot block
10c631125e29b635579fb12a76ab1bcf80c2743c.summary: Pittsburgh said Tuesday that 19-year-old forward Ben Kindel is day-to-day with a lower-body injury after leaving Monday’s preseason win over Buffalo late in the first period when he blocked a shot with his foot. Kindel had centered a line with Bryan Rust and Andrei Kuzmenko before exiting. With Blake Lizotte also banged up, the Penguins’ center depth is already a story as camp rolls toward the Sept. 30 opener.

51bc4570441adae9e66db69d433188ca58f18ce9.headline: New England fall foliage 2026: healthier color after a wet reset, slower peak march
51bc4570441adae9e66db69d433188ca58f18ce9.summary: WBUR’s free foliage outlook says New England’s 2026 color season should look healthier than last year’s dull, early drop after a classic snowy winter and summer rain recharged soils. Peak still marches north-to-south — far northern New England late September, central mid-October, coastal Connecticut late October into early November — but a gradual cooldown may stretch the show. Early color seekers should head north over the next couple of weeks.

58fd728570f4c873fbcc169ee010eaf2346e4639.headline: Bridgeport resident wins $30,000 lottery ticket sold at Trumbull Food Mart
58fd728570f4c873fbcc169ee010eaf2346e4639.summary: A Bridgeport resident is $30,000 richer after buying a winning Connecticut Lottery “DIAMOND BINGO” ticket at Trumbull Food Mart LLC on Monday, Patch reported Tuesday. The CT Lottery confirmed the prize as a public record but no longer publishes winners’ full names without written consent, a privacy change that took effect Oct. 1, 2025. The win is a light local bright spot for Trumbull shoppers this week.

7e7081d66586a1a623d3420d87345be1858b50cb.headline: Trump plans rare tarmac welcome for Xi as three-day Washington state visit begins
7e7081d66586a1a623d3420d87345be1858b50cb.summary: President Trump is expected to greet Chinese President Xi Jinping on the tarmac at Joint Base Andrews rather than waiting at the White House — a rare planeside welcome to open Xi’s first U.S. state visit in more than a decade. Melania Trump said her husband wanted to show “the most respect,” while Sen. Roger Wicker criticized a “lavish welcome” amid tensions over trade, AI, Iran, and Taiwan. A White House state dinner Thursday is set to include tech leaders such as Nvidia’s Jensen Huang and SpaceX’s Elon Musk.

d89cd11d8c185de88ce6855ec398923724a168c8.headline: LEGO reveals first-ever PlayStation set — 1,911 pieces with functional buttons
d89cd11d8c185de88ce6855ec398923724a168c8.summary: The LEGO Group unveiled set 72306, a near 1:1 brick replica of the original grey PlayStation console and first controller, with functional Open and Power buttons and a plug-in controller. Hidden buildable dioramas nod to Gran Turismo and Ape Escape. Priced at $179.99, the 1,911-piece 18+ set opens for LEGO Insiders early access Oct. 1 and for everyone Oct. 4 after a State of Play reveal.

0e4c54e6ac75c61e5c2e32a0a2274fb3e71d8004.headline: Apple Watch Ultra 4 ships with Health Sensing System, readiness score, longer battery
0e4c54e6ac75c61e5c2e32a0a2274fb3e71d8004.summary: Apple’s Watch Ultra 4 pairs the new Health Sensing System and S11 chip for denser all-day heart-rate and HRV readings plus a 0–10 readiness score for training days. Outdoor workout tracking stretches up to 45 hours in Max Extended Workout mode, with everyday battery life rated up to 50 hours. Natural and black titanium models started at $799 with store availability beginning Sept. 18.

a29f414630343e9942ebf6cbe4be58a93e8e27e6.headline: Matt Walsh jokes he’ll take WNBA commissioner job — at a 50% pay cut
a29f414630343e9942ebf6cbe4be58a93e8e27e6.summary: After WNBA Commissioner Cathy Engelbert said she will retire at year’s end, Matt Walsh told Benny Johnson he would “accept the position” despite barely watching the sport. Walsh quipped he would take 50% less pay than the outgoing commissioner to “even the score.” The tongue-in-cheek bid lands amid broader culture fights over player safety online and transgender eligibility debates around the league.

34c7d607714adc32f9857c1aa20ddcd7a09bb8e8.headline: Elon Musk keeps Tesla–SpaceX merger talk alive after All-In Summit remarks
34c7d607714adc32f9857c1aa20ddcd7a09bb8e8.summary: At the All-In Summit, Elon Musk declined to shut down questions about combining Tesla and SpaceX, pointing to “so much close collaboration” across the companies. SpaceX COO Gwynne Shotwell separately said staff and projects are integrating faster than expected, including work tied to Terafab chip manufacturing in Texas. No merger agreement, timetable, or deal structure has been announced — only renewed speculation after SpaceX’s June public listing.

5fd7bf8c0e7dc4a5393c8a1f1680dc269db40f34.headline: Erika Kirk sends anniversary video message to Truth & Liberty Conference
5fd7bf8c0e7dc4a5393c8a1f1680dc269db40f34.summary: On the one-year anniversary of Charlie Kirk’s killing, Erika Kirk delivered a prerecorded address of gratitude and resolve to the free Truth & Liberty Conference in Woodland Park, Colo. Organizers said the message urged attendees to keep standing for faith and freedom as Charlie did. The Sept. 10–12 gathering tightened security as Utah courts separately ordered accused shooter Tyler Robinson to stand trial.

23ac2db08bf114a6a165a4dd3d6ec38149071dd5.headline: Penguins fall 7–4 to Red Wings as Ruck twins and Robertson debut highlights
23ac2db08bf114a6a165a4dd3d6ec38149071dd5.summary: Pittsburgh dropped its second preseason game 7–4 to Detroit, but 2026 draft picks Liam and Markus Ruck made strong first impressions in black and gold. Liam posted two assists and Markus set up Rutger McGroarty, while Nick Robertson notched a highlight-reel shorthanded goal in his Pens debut. Coach Dan Muse praised the twins’ engagement and said more practice and games will help goalie Arturs Silovs settle in.

bc3d9351aa76f74a1f8692431cfd0d1d5ea2e801.headline: Jets promote Heflin and McClain, place Onyemata, McCrary-Ball, and Smith on IR
bc3d9351aa76f74a1f8692431cfd0d1d5ea2e801.summary: New York signed DL Jack Heflin and WR Malik McClain from the practice squad to the active roster Tuesday after injuries mounted. DL David Onyemata (groin), LB Marcelino McCrary-Ball (ankle), and WR Arian Smith (knee) went on injured reserve; Smith’s injury came against Green Bay. The Jets also added DT Isaiahh Loudermilk and TE Cody Hardy to the practice squad as they prep for Detroit.

449ec180a236f9cb0065b75ef397c3952bce306d.headline: Insta360 Luna Ultra firmware adds 15× zoom, Stage Mode, and 4K vertical video
449ec180a236f9cb0065b75ef397c3952bce306d.summary: Insta360’s Sept. 21 Luna Ultra update pushes in-camera zoom to 15× (about 300mm equivalent) and pairs with a new Ultra Telephoto Lens for up to ~450mm reach. Stage Mode tunes tracking, exposure, and audio for concerts, while 4K30 vertical video targets social clips. A Zoom Bundle with carry bag and telephoto lens lists at $889.99 via the Insta360 app update path.

6d3b367cd1f44fcebbee2427d4df04a7e02e9ca1.headline: Karen Woodall: treat enmeshment after divorce as coercive control of a child’s mind
6d3b367cd1f44fcebbee2427d4df04a7e02e9ca1.summary: In a Sept. 18 essay, clinician Karen Woodall argues coercive control is more than a checklist of adult behaviors — it can shrink a child’s psychological freedom inside enmeshed or disorganized caregiving. She urges post-divorce assessors to test how a child’s rigid alignment or rejection developed, not merely accept stated wishes at face value. The piece ties into her forthcoming Routledge book The Journey of the Alienated Child and Family Separation Clinic training.

58f3c6c3fb115ac7bed820ade4ce42b4260092b9.headline: USA fall foliage 2026: Northeast rebound, early West color, drought pockets up north
58f3c6c3fb115ac7bed820ade4ce42b4260092b9.summary: ABC News/GMA’s Sept. 22 foliage outlook says the Northeast is primed for a stronger color season after two drought-dulled autumns, with many areas peaking in early October and coasts later. Western states such as Colorado and Utah are already showing color a bit early amid heat and dryness. Severe drought in Wisconsin’s North Woods and Michigan’s U.P. may mute vibrancy even as average peak maps still point to early October for the Upper Midwest.

3b2635eb928589e1bc00e42670ed0e6f72b156c7.headline: Harley-Davidson repeats as 2026 Mission AFT SuperTwins manufacturer champion
3b2635eb928589e1bc00e42670ed0e6f72b156c7.summary: Harley-Davidson sealed the 2026 Mission AFT SuperTwins manufacturer title after Springfield Mile, finishing with 331 points — 17 clear of Yamaha. Kody Kopp led Harley riders with three wins and a runner-up season finish on an XG750R, while Briar Bauman added six victories en route to third. James Rispoli capped the weekend by leading a Route 66 Ride to the Race from Shorewood, Ill., to the track.

7a9b4ae50e109b0a70af0872eaa2acdba66d2a69.headline: Jeep launches “This Is Jeep Country” national campaign spanning the full lineup
7a9b4ae50e109b0a70af0872eaa2acdba66d2a69.summary: Jeep’s Sept. 9 “This Is Jeep Country” campaign frames America as the brand’s first customer and ties 85 years of 4x4 heritage to freedom and grit. Spots and digital films show Wrangler, Gladiator, Grand Cherokee, Recon, and other models across deserts, forests, mountains, and coasts, plus owner UGC. Media buys stretch across NFL, streaming (Disney+, Paramount+, Max, Peacock), and Hispanic/AA digital extensions via agency Highdive.

f6f151053fbb1957876b126f191668d071124f26.headline: Pantera headlining The Great Nola Trendkill festival in New Orleans this November
f6f151053fbb1957876b126f191668d071124f26.summary: Housecore Horror, Housecore Records, and Live Nation set The Great Nola Trendkill for Nov. 20–21 at Lakefront Arena, headlined by Pantera’s first New Orleans show in 30 years and a celebration of The Great Southern Trendkill’s anniversary. DOWN will stage its Volume V release show the same weekend, with Black Label Society, Corrosion of Conformity, Power Trip, Crowbar, Eyehategod, and more. Philip Anselmo called returning home with the package “a dream come true.”

dc8f627b430e910546ba12060657383753ece85d.headline: Trumbull leaf pickup starts Nov. 4 — track progress on the town map
dc8f627b430e910546ba12060657383753ece85d.summary: Trumbull Public Works announced Wednesday details for the 2026 loose-leaf collection program, which is expected to begin Nov. 4 and run until every neighborhood is cleared. Equipment will be tested the week before, weather can delay routes, and residents can follow a daily-updated leaf pickup progress map on the town site. Bagged leaf pickup can also be requested as often as needed during the season.

fcdfda04f1592b98032f8044709c2b7246c7dcd7.headline: MAGA-aligned PACs dump $163M into ads — much of it defending deep-red districts
fcdfda04f1592b98032f8044709c2b7246c7dcd7.summary: Three Trump-aligned groups — MAGA Inc., No Going Back PAC and Safety and Affordability PAC — have spent more than $163 million on ads since Sept. 1, with nearly 40% going to states and districts Trump won by 10 points or more in 2024, an AP AdImpact analysis found. Republicans are flush with cash but glum about gas prices, the Iran war, and midterm headwinds as some candidates distance themselves from White House policies.

51cda294b463eff8d8269fdf527b77f02a084509.headline: CNN, Politico, MS NOW face Trump admin in court over White House media ban
51cda294b463eff8d8269fdf527b77f02a084509.summary: CNN, Politico and MS NOW argued Wednesday before Trump-appointed Judge Timothy Kelly that their White House expulsion is unconstitutional viewpoint discrimination. DOJ says access is a “privilege,” citing alleged falsehoods and sensitive reporting; Trump called the ban an assault on “FAKE NEWS” and vowed to appeal if he loses. More than four dozen media groups filed an amicus brief urging the ban be lifted.

7827fc352ba7a4c396c943c4c6a9b1d73e8cb28a.headline: Judge orders ICE-shot Venezuelan delivery driver to appear Sept. 30 as video emerges
7827fc352ba7a4c396c943c4c6a9b1d73e8cb28a.summary: Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, 28, was back in ICE detention with a bullet still in his back after an Austin shooting by a federal immigration officer, his attorney said. A federal judge ordered him to appear Sept. 30 in San Antonio as lawyers seek to block removal; Austin police released body-cam showing him wounded in his car after a DoorDash delivery encounter that sparked Capitol protests.

515739e994e5f01b44722dd26595518862496691.headline: Tesla rolls out in-car Grok Connectors for email, calendar, and files
515739e994e5f01b44722dd26595518862496691.summary: Tesla expanded Grok inside vehicles with Connectors that let drivers manage inbox, calendar, and files hands-free by voice. Agent-style tasks such as coffee orders and restaurant bookings are currently limited to SuperGrok Heavy subscribers, with broader tiers promised later. The update follows Grok 4.7’s release and builds on recent in-car browsing and messaging features.

8479535e9fb64911fdc81b643e2312f89c557989.headline: Apple ships iOS 27 with Siri AI, stronger Screen Time, and Liquid Glass tweaks
8479535e9fb64911fdc81b643e2312f89c557989.summary: Apple’s major platform updates are rolling out across iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27 and more, led by Siri AI — a more conversational assistant with personal context and onscreen awareness, launching as an English beta. Parents get redesigned Screen Time and Ask to Browse controls, while Photos, Safari, and performance upgrades land systemwide. Some Apple Intelligence features carry daily usage limits and regional restrictions.

021af25b7bd2b964189c1d223b95196f2640a389.headline: LEGO Batman Returns Batmobile: 2,269 pieces with button-reveal Batmissile
021af25b7bd2b964189c1d223b95196f2640a389.summary: The LEGO Group unveiled set 76355, a 2,269-piece recreation of the Tim Burton Batman Returns Batmobile with a first-of-its-kind button that splits the body to reveal a hidden Batmissile escape vehicle. The $229.99 adult display set includes six Easter eggs, three new elements, and an exclusive Batman minifigure with a newly moulded cape. Insiders early access began Sept. 1; general sale followed Sept. 4.

e758b9582aa3a787e96049b40a1ca846eb43e5f8.headline: Jets Stock Report: No. 1 defense and Bailey’s pressures head into Lions week
e758b9582aa3a787e96049b40a1ca846eb43e5f8.summary: Despite a 20–17 OT loss to Green Bay, the Jets rank No. 1 in total defense through two games, allowing the fewest yards and first downs in the NFL. Rookie edge David Bailey already has two sacks and rare early-career pressure rates, while safeties Andre Cisco and Dane Belton have locked down the middle since Minkah Fitzpatrick’s injury. Next up: a reeling Detroit Lions defense ranked last in yards and points allowed.

fc740c4bbdd83760e8375ac44f37af2fec63b9b6.headline: Ruck twins share ‘pretty special’ Penguins preseason debut on the same line
fc740c4bbdd83760e8375ac44f37af2fec63b9b6.summary: 2026 draft picks Liam (No. 22) and Markus Ruck (No. 39) debuted together for Pittsburgh against Detroit, skating on the same line in a 7–4 preseason loss. Coach Dan Muse praised their camp progress; Markus only got in after Ville Koivunen’s injury. The Medicine Hat WHL stars — nearly identical off the ice — called sharing an NHL jersey with Crosby and Malkin nearby a lifelong dream.

93d2cfda769a6db33e05a7354b35dc54e6c7e816.headline: Bullet For My Valentine: Dimebag’s Vulgar Display tone is the ‘most iconic’ ever
93d2cfda769a6db33e05a7354b35dc54e6c7e816.summary: In a resurfaced MusicRadar interview, Matt Tuck named Pantera’s Vulgar Display of Power as the most iconic guitar tone of all time — “crushing… honky and scooped,” with lead tones so individual “no-one else sounded like that.” Tuck argued Dimebag’s identity lived in his hands: give someone else the same guitar and amp and it “would sound like dogs**t.” The piece also covers BFMV’s simpler Gravity-era tracking approach.

345837f5e8fbdb7f558e56beacf873f47e1c4152.headline: Jeep and Harley-Davidson reunite communities at European Bike Week 2026
345837f5e8fbdb7f558e56beacf873f47e1c4152.summary: Jeep and Harley-Davidson highlighted their renewed European partnership at Faaker See’s European Bike Week, showcasing Avenger 4xe and Compass hybrids with test drives for riders and Jeep fans. The 2014-born collaboration was refreshed for 2026 events that organizers say have reached up to 200,000 participants. Autumn stops continue with Ladies of Harley in Pescara (Oct. 3) and a H.O.G. Winter Meeting in Genoa (Nov. 28).

bf72a94a65e91411032be3e9f96c23b5173420d0.headline: Erika Kirk marks Charlie’s death anniversary: ‘Until heaven’
bf72a94a65e91411032be3e9f96c23b5173420d0.summary: On the first anniversary of Charlie Kirk’s Sept. 10, 2025 assassination, Erika Kirk posted a black-and-white wedding photo with the caption “… Until heaven.” She continues as Turning Point USA CEO; accused gunman Tyler Robinson has pleaded not guilty and is due back in court Oct. 23. The family thanked supporters and said they remain committed to justice and a transparent process.

28e45000f97fdfcb4893e576a994293f04bb94d0.headline: Dr. Amy J.L. Baker: parental alienation is unjustified rejection — not estrangement
28e45000f97fdfcb4893e576a994293f04bb94d0.summary: Developmental psychologist Amy J.L. Baker defines parental alienation as one parent’s behaviors fostering a child’s unjustified rejection of the other parent — distinct from estrangement after real abuse. She outlines 17 alienating strategies, urges targeted parents to show up calmly and document contact, and compares unseen nurturing to planting a winter bulb that may bloom later. The free episode also covers coaching and court-facing documentation habits.

d5d748d9ff93a79a68549319944929312943372f.headline: Free USA foliage map ranks peak color for every county, park, and forest
d5d748d9ff93a79a68549319944929312943372f.summary: Filmmakers Will and Jim Pattiz launched a free More Than Just Parks Foliage Map covering all 3,104 lower-48 counties plus 1,600+ public lands, including every national park and forest with enough canopy to forecast. Enter a ZIP and weekend to rank nearby peaks, spot dual-peak forests (aspen then larch), and check live cameras and reservation flags before you drive. The model updates daily with weather and ground reports.

f273c07206fff1b205b2e6cf2c9b97214ac831b8.headline: Trumbull Arts Festival lineup set for Sunday on Town Hall Green
f273c07206fff1b205b2e6cf2c9b97214ac831b8.summary: Trumbull’s Arts Festival returns Sunday, Sept. 27, from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. on the Town Hall Green with a free artisans market of 60+ local makers, a food-truck court, and a children’s creative tent. Gazebo acts include Tom Weber Children’s Music, Yoga for Everybody, Molly Bryce, and Mass Conn Fusion Quartet. Entry and parking are free; bring lawn chairs or blankets.

390c9843e5435cae6b06038defb29d47aad062fd.headline: Judge: White House skipped due process before CNN / Politico media ban
390c9843e5435cae6b06038defb29d47aad062fd.summary: Trump-appointed Judge Timothy Kelly said Wednesday the White House appears not to have followed required pre-deprivation notice before stripping CNN, MS NOW, and Politico press passes, but he did not rule immediately. DOJ called access a “privilege” and cited national-security reporting; the outlets and a 50-group amicus brief call it viewpoint discrimination. Trump vowed to appeal if he loses.

d6e1cd042a246039934568288149358db15ec3b6.headline: AP-KFF poll: rural voters still lean Trump, but pocketbook pain is rising
d6e1cd042a246039934568288149358db15ec3b6.summary: About half of rural registered voters say the economy is worse than when Trump returned to office, an AP-KFF survey finds, with groceries, gas, and healthcare topping worries. Trump still posts 48% rural approval — higher than adults overall — but down from 56% in an earlier rural poll, and only ~4 in 10 approve of his economic handling. Respondents often trust their own party more than they plan to switch sides.

02a8f8cdf348f1a51be2afcbebd32d6e81d10105.headline: AP Exclusive: ICE hides locator data for thousands with final removal orders
02a8f8cdf348f1a51be2afcbebd32d6e81d10105.summary: ICE quietly dropped detainees with final removal orders from its public online locator on Sept. 15, current and former officials told AP, leaving lawyers and families unable to find clients before deportation. Nearly 16,000 July bookings involved people with final orders; court-ordered exceptions remain at Adelanto and a few temporary sites. ICE neither confirmed nor denied the practice while saying final-order cases are deportation priorities.

0fdc5a07c7d7caa9006f9a26a7b96eeee94d4d24.headline: Jets: Arian Smith out for season after ACL surgery; Onyemata sidelined weeks
0fdc5a07c7d7caa9006f9a26a7b96eeee94d4d24.summary: HC Aaron Glenn confirmed Wednesday that WR Arian Smith had season-ending ACL surgery after Sunday’s Packers game, while DT David Onyemata’s core-muscle surgery will cost him several weeks. Mason Taylor, Minkah Fitzpatrick, Kene Nwangwu, and Kiko Mauigoa did not practice; Joseph Ossai is “very close.” The Jets also praised practice-squad QB Will Levis as a developmental add ahead of Detroit.

6dbf84c8f2d022cf79c91fa098965442da1202ac.headline: LEGO holiday wave: Icons Holiday House and Buddy the Elf lead Oct. 1 drop
6dbf84c8f2d022cf79c91fa098965442da1202ac.summary: The LEGO Group unveiled seven festive 2026 sets led by the 1,354-piece Icons Holiday House (11387) inspired by Jingle Bells, with Insiders early access Oct. 1 and general sale Oct. 4 at $119.99. Also arriving: Buddy the Elf, upscaled Mrs. Claus, ornaments, Santa’s sleigh, a countdown calendar, and a brick Christmas stocking. Private Insider shopping nights are set for mid-November.

ac1399ec9f45a6efff33b7d39d77c87dda7fc5fd.headline: LEGO confirms first Dragon Ball set is imminent — Adults Welcome teaser
ac1399ec9f45a6efff33b7d39d77c87dda7fc5fd.summary: Brickset reports LEGO’s social teaser confirms a Dragon Ball set is coming, showing seven Dragon Balls and an Adults Welcome logo that points to an 18+ model. Details are scarce beyond the IP reveal; fans widely expect a large Shenron Icons-style display build, with broader Dragon Ball play sets rumored for 2027. The confirmation follows months of licensing speculation after LEGO’s anime expansions.

9b78cef408b4341af99ae160fdf2a22b11a0f361.headline: Apple Watch Series 12: Health Sensing System, readiness score, Audio Intelligence
9b78cef408b4341af99ae160fdf2a22b11a0f361.summary: Apple’s Series 12 pairs a new Health Sensing System and S11 chip for higher-frequency heart rate and HRV sensing, a daily readiness score, and later Audio Intelligence features such as Live Rewind and Siri Recap. Everyday battery remains up to 24 hours with faster top-ups; aluminum, titanium, and new ceramic finishes start at $399. Availability began Sept. 18 alongside watchOS 27 and Siri AI.

c06b3f1b4a2b0d852ca9beff076751096a222016.headline: Kaeden Korczak: Pens trade opened space to ‘reach more of my full potential’
c06b3f1b4a2b0d852ca9beff076751096a222016.summary: Defenseman Kaeden Korczak, acquired from Vegas for Parker Wotherspoon, said his head was “spinning” when the call came — then settled into Pittsburgh’s sports town and camp. Assistant GM Jason Spezza cited upside, defensive solidity, and middle-aged roster fit; Korczak has been paired with Sam Girard and is studying Karlsson and Letang. The 25-year-old played a career-high 78 games last season and tasted a Stanley Cup Final run.

0ac2edd8d3c34bcd66a22e79e47d924ec597074a.headline: Matt Walsh calls Netflix ‘neck injury’ anniversary post ‘despicable’
0ac2edd8d3c34bcd66a22e79e47d924ec597074a.summary: Netflix UK & Ireland posted “Nearly did himself a neck injury” on Sept. 10 — the first anniversary of Charlie Kirk’s assassination by a neck shot — prompting Matt Walsh and others to call the timing intentional and urge cancellations. Netflix later said the caption referred to a Gentlemen wedding scene and denied any Kirk link. Critics note a year of online “neck injury” memes made the date hard to ignore.

56e725efee6becc27ff263f0cfe6192c12d30d9a.headline: Karen Woodall: Lighthouse Keeping maps repair after coerced child rejection
56e725efee6becc27ff263f0cfe6192c12d30d9a.summary: In a free essay, Karen Woodall describes six years building “Lighthouse Keeping” — a parent-mediated repair pathway for children forced to reject a parent after divorce. She argues labels and court battles obscured the child’s attachment trauma, and centers steady, right-action-at-the-right-time responses instead of rescue programs. Her book The Journey of the Alienated Child and a clinical handbook are due later in 2026.

05d485dccdbda949902d53c290089d7ac1c66744.headline: Post–Labor Day USA parks window: Yosemite, Glacier, Arches drop timed entry
05d485dccdbda949902d53c290089d7ac1c66744.summary: Yosemite, Glacier, and Arches dropped peak-season vehicle timed-entry systems for 2026, opening a quieter post–Labor Day shoulder season while many roads and trails stay open. Rocky Mountain kept timed entry through mid-October but offers classic elk-rut viewing from roads with distance rules. Shenandoah’s Skyline Drive remains reservation-free as early color begins at higher elevations.

379a9286bea9ad88f0531340fc4f332fd27a82a4.headline: Trumbull Veterans and First Responders Center enters final construction phase
379a9286bea9ad88f0531340fc4f332fd27a82a4.summary: VFW Post 10059’s 5,500-square-foot Veterans and First Responders Center in Trumbull is in its final construction phase after nearly a decade of planning, pandemic delays, and a $900,000 state grant. The multi-use hub will serve veterans, first responders, small businesses, and residents of Trumbull, Shelton, Monroe, Easton, and Redding, with completion targeted by year-end. Recent private gifts totaling $35,000 added a generator and a Wall of Honor near the entrance.

9dc3d1663db28a5c243bb1e3380c8c072faccc4e.headline: DOJ ramps up noncitizen voting prosecutions ahead of November midterms
9dc3d1663db28a5c243bb1e3380c8c072faccc4e.summary: The Justice Department has charged about 20 people this month under the federal “voting by aliens” statute — roughly 13% of all such cases since the law was enacted — and 32 in the last four weeks, Reuters reports. DHS has mobilized agents in all 50 states, calling the work a White House “tier-one priority,” while critics say the push erodes public trust despite studies showing noncitizen voting is rare. A separate Reuters review found states may have added more than 30,000 self-declared noncitizens to rolls since 2000 through software and clerical errors.

c466c16f29c3a919f02f0c9223e6d51d6c0f348f.headline: AP: U.S. citizen left bloodied after ICE agents mistook him for a fugitive
c466c16f29c3a919f02f0c9223e6d51d6c0f348f.summary: A U.S. citizen was injured and hospitalized Sunday in Evanston, Illinois, after ICE agents mistook him for a fugitive, refused his ID demands turned into a struggle, then released him once they confirmed he was not their target. Witnesses told AP agents pinned the man — who yelled he was a citizen — and left blood on his shirt and face; DHS said he was “not cooperative” and that officers left without further incident. Evanston police are investigating as Illinois officials condemn the encounter amid record ICE arrest numbers.

3bec9c020298fe82552e4ec34e2e357f3d3fbb4f.headline: Kirk family notice of claim hinges on UVU chief’s ‘I got you covered’ text
3bec9c020298fe82552e4ec34e2e357f3d3fbb4f.summary: Charlie Kirk’s family filed a notice of claim against Utah, Utah Valley University, and officials alleging rooftop-security failures before his Sept. 10, 2025 assassination. Attorneys highlight an alleged UVU Police Chief Jeffrey Long text — “I got you covered” — after TPUSA organizers raised rooftop-access concerns, arguing reliance on that assurance may help pierce Utah’s governmental immunity. The notice says no officer was on the rooftop and camera feeds were not watched in real time; Tyler Robinson has pleaded not guilty to aggravated murder.

9eb554b36623a1a814337be4088ebf6ffa6ae18b.headline: ICE shooting lawyer deletes post joking about Charlie Kirk’s neck wound
9eb554b36623a1a814337be4088ebf6ffa6ae18b.summary: Kate Lincoln-Goldfinch, attorney for Venezuelan DoorDash driver Wilber Garces Perez shot by ICE in Austin, deleted a social post asking “How do you resist getting shot in the neck? Does Charlie Kirk have any advice on that?” Conservatives including Nancy Mace and Charlie Kirk Show staff called the timing grotesque; she told Fox the post “could be misconstrued” and was removed. DHS continues to defend the traffic-stop shooting while she disputes the government’s account of her client’s status and medical care.

d30496183f3a8f159f464466c027a3567451121b.headline: Bessent: U.S. and China extend Busan trade truce through January 10
d30496183f3a8f159f464466c027a3567451121b.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Wednesday the United States and China agreed to extend the so-called Busan trade truce until January 10, after he met Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng ahead of President Xi Jinping’s Washington state visit. Bessent told Fox News the sides also discussed whether a broader deal was possible beyond a series of smaller steps. The extension pushes past the prior November 10 expiration as Trump hosts Xi for pomp-and-ceremony diplomacy amid trade and technology tensions.

fe766dbe2b28e2f92d5dcecf25f3aac124b7fc0e.headline: Apple exploring screenless fitness band as Watch lineup rethink
fe766dbe2b28e2f92d5dcecf25f3aac124b7fc0e.summary: Citing Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, MacRumors reports Apple has built prototypes of a screenless Apple Watch–style fitness band as it re-evaluates the Watch lineup for a “new era.” Screen-free trackers from Whoop, Oura, and Google have gained ground on distraction, weight, and battery life. Apple has reportedly not locked a direction — smart rings and even a circular Watch display are also under study — and a screenless band is not expected before at least 2028.

06aea1799bd09ec83b900fa73bfe9734fc346c4b.headline: OpenAI: ChatGPT-in-Siri deal ‘persistently underperforming’ vs xAI suit
06aea1799bd09ec83b900fa73bfe9734fc346c4b.summary: In a court filing against Elon Musk’s xAI, OpenAI said Apple’s ChatGPT integration in Siri was “persistently underperforming,” with early forecasts cut after a slow opt-in start. OpenAI argues there was never an exclusivity deal — Apple refused a two-year exclusive and later signed with Google/Gemini — and that foreclosure of rivals was de minimis. Musk’s companies dropped Apple from the suit earlier this month; OpenAI wants xAI’s remaining claims tossed before a January 2027 trial.

be481ca7e5b3ae7c9affb42c8692807fa7e7ae87.headline: Jets: Aaron Glenn’s Motor City reunion vs Dan Campbell and No. 1 defense
be481ca7e5b3ae7c9affb42c8692807fa7e7ae87.summary: For the first time as Jets head coach, Aaron Glenn returns to Detroit to face former boss Dan Campbell after four seasons as Lions defensive coordinator. New York’s defense ranks No. 1 overall and top-five against both run and pass, holding its first two foes under 200 yards, while Detroit averages 362 yards with Goff, Gibbs, and St. Brown. Lions defensive injuries (Branch, Joseph, Maddox) and a unit allowing 10 TDs in two weeks give the Jets’ WR duo of Wilson and Mitchell a secondary to test.

a99ca1d3674cc222e0d6f0f919a7930047303b0c.headline: Penguins cut nine, loan Galvas to Czechia, waive Gauthier for AHL
a99ca1d3674cc222e0d6f0f919a7930047303b0c.summary: On their preseason off day, the Penguins trimmed nine players, including loaning 2026 second-rounder Tomas Galvas back to Bili Tygri Liberec in Czechia after a rocky NHL preseason debut. Goaltender Taylor Gauthier was waived for assignment to Wilkes-Barre/Scranton; most others were AHL-contract defensemen plus junior forward Carter Sanderson. Pittsburgh still had about 59 players in camp with another exhibition looming before the regular-season roster crunch.

19de4b11657268b38c748e2b3fc6a501dc3b06d1.headline: Judge orders White House to restore CNN, MS NOW, and Politico access
19de4b11657268b38c748e2b3fc6a501dc3b06d1.summary: U.S. District Judge Timothy Kelly ordered early Thursday that the White House immediately restore hard-pass access for CNN, MS NOW, and Politico, granting a 14-day temporary restraining order after finding the outlets were likely revoked without due process. Kelly — a Trump first-term nominee — rejected the administration’s national-security justification, noting Trump’s Truth Social ban focused on “fake news” and negativity, not security. The outlets’ lawyer called it a strong ruling for press freedom; the White House did not immediately comment, and Trump had already signaled an appeal.

982c7d2d3ce87e328faa4e18ed61dc0807ed4df5.headline: Trumbull cemetery lands on new CT Haunted History Trail map
982c7d2d3ce87e328faa4e18ed61dc0807ed4df5.summary: Gov. Ned Lamont’s office launched the Connecticut Haunted History Trail, a statewide tourism map of more than 130 haunted landmarks, cemeteries, witch-trial sites, and paranormal attractions — including Gregory’s Four Corners Burial Grounds in Trumbull, home of the Hannah Cranna “Wicked Witch of Monroe” grave. The free interactive map at CTvisit.com spans nine categories and builds on earlier Pizza, Christmas Movie, and Oyster trails. Officials frame it as history-plus-tourism ahead of Halloween travel season.

229335280dd8a390db022de0290030a623c60528.headline: Trump and Xi sit down in Washington with trade truce extended, hard issues open
229335280dd8a390db022de0290030a623c60528.summary: Presidents Trump and Xi Jinping enter Thursday’s White House summit after greeting each other planeside Wednesday and agreeing to extend the Busan trade truce to January 10. AP notes both leaders still believe time favors their side while Iran leverage, Taiwan arms sales, advanced-chip controls, and an AI-incident notification idea remain unresolved. Trump is leaning into pomp — South Lawn helipad ready, tech CEOs on the state-dinner guest list — even as analysts expect small gains and conflict avoidance rather than a breakthrough.

b96cbedf46fb37eabaecd9477f78749c855fb71a.headline: ICE-shot Austin delivery driver needs spine surgery; agent reportedly had no body cam
b96cbedf46fb37eabaecd9477f78749c855fb71a.summary: Rep. Greg Casar said Wednesday that Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, the Venezuelan DoorDash driver shot by ICE in Austin, needs surgery to remove a bullet lodged near his spine and remains in detention with limited pain care. Separate reports said the recent ICE recruit who fired had been issued a body camera but was not wearing it; another officer’s cam did not capture the shooting. DHS still frames the stop as a dangerous evasion attempt, while attorneys seek to block deportation ahead of a Sept. 30 hearing.

8d24359304ffec19656317e4e5d592ae8e8c3b53.headline: Apple testing iOS 27.0.1 after iPhone 18 Pro Face ID complaints
8d24359304ffec19656317e4e5d592ae8e8c3b53.summary: Days after shipping iOS 27, Apple is already testing iOS 27.0.1 for iPhones, MacRumors logs show — typically a bug-fix and security patch wave. Some iPhone 18 Pro owners have reported Face ID problems, making that a likely target. watchOS 27.0.1 is already out for Series 12 and Ultra 4 and fixes unexpected restarts; a public iOS 27.0.1 drop is expected in the next few days or weeks.

a285b270ec9078850e82a7a9961dd8c685a68e2b.headline: Meta’s Connect ‘one more thing’: Muse Charm AI Tamagotchi puck
a285b270ec9078850e82a7a9961dd8c685a68e2b.summary: Mark Zuckerberg closed Meta Connect by unveiling Muse Charm — a keychain-sized puck with a fingerprint sensor and a Tamagotchi-like avatar for chatting with Muse AI without unlocking a phone. Meta aims for holiday availability while also announcing lighter tethered Meta VR Glasses ($1,300, spring), audio-only Ray-Ban glasses from $349 shipping Oct. 13, and refreshed camera Ray-Bans from $449. The gadget lane lands as Apple has reportedly shelved its own AI pendant plans.

43e166b616c9031c55b45afa674d7ede8e593b06.headline: Penguins preseason lineup vs Columbus features both Ruck twins
43e166b616c9031c55b45afa674d7ede8e593b06.summary: Pittsburgh listed its Thursday preseason lineup for Columbus at Nationwide Arena (7:00 PM ET on 105.9 The X), putting Liam Ruck and Markus Ruck on the same forward group after their joint debut buzz. The deep prospect/AHL mix also includes Rutger McGroarty, Ville Koivunen, Elmer Soderblom, and goalies Sergei Murashov and Collin Delia. The game is the next look after Wednesday’s wave of roster cuts ahead of the 2026-27 open.

aa855974a9288fb9116233b02cac59e486aa1660.headline: Jets Week 3 injury report: Fitzpatrick, Mauigoa, Taylor miss Wednesday practice
aa855974a9288fb9116233b02cac59e486aa1660.summary: Heading into Sunday’s Motor City reunion at Detroit, the Jets listed safeties Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin), linebacker Kiko Mauigoa (quad), running back Kene Nwangwu (back), and tight end Mason Taylor (thumb) as Wednesday DNPs. Edge Joseph Ossai was limited with a foot injury while David Bailey practiced fully despite an elbow issue. Detroit also showed several limited or out starters on the first midweek report of Week 3.

cfb5b0b4e9e0b46e55d4173ec264ebd5e82a5d25.headline: Candace Owens challenges Erika Kirk footage metadata — demands on-record answer
cfb5b0b4e9e0b46e55d4173ec264ebd5e82a5d25.summary: Candace Owens reignited her clash with Andrew Wilson over family footage tied to Charlie Kirk’s final hours, arguing iPhone metadata can be edited and does not alone prove authenticity. She called public sharing of private moments with Kirk’s children “deeply disturbing” and said a simple on-record statement from Erika Kirk would settle who recorded the clip. Owens also needled Wilson to focus on Tyler Robinson’s aggravated-murder charges instead of the video fight.

849486a057c27e44190fb64f126eb18a6d36e6a6.headline: Fall color map: early yellows in northern New England and Great Lakes
849486a057c27e44190fb64f126eb18a6d36e6a6.summary: WeatherBug’s Sept. 22 foliage update says fall has “entered the chat” but most of the Lower 48 is still green. Beginning color is concentrated in northern Maine, pockets of Vermont/New Hampshire/upstate New York, the western Great Lakes near Lake Superior, and high Rockies/Southwest elevations. Southern New England including Connecticut remains predominantly green; the outlet will refresh the national map each Tuesday through peak season.

1451be691a641b0e6b042ce73b6f61a58eccc68b.headline: Tesla Semi factory ‘Rollout’ lands today in Sparks — ceremonial opening after April production
1451be691a641b0e6b042ce73b6f61a58eccc68b.summary: Tesla’s invite-only Semi Rollout is set for Sept. 24 at the dedicated 1.7-million-square-foot Semi plant beside Gigafactory Nevada in Sparks — a ribbon-cutting months after high-volume production began in April. The plant is aimed at 50,000 Class 8 trucks a year with Standard (325-mile) and Long Range (500-mile) variants, Megacharger support, and factory tours plus Semi ride-alongs for RSVP’d guests 21+. Analysts still peg 2026 deliveries well below nameplate capacity as the ramp continues.

2c4868ccde41b38620f9ab9125ae2119638be621.headline: LEGO Harry Potter Ministry of Magic Collectors’ Edition: 3,491 pieces, $449.99
2c4868ccde41b38620f9ab9125ae2119638be621.summary: Marking 25 years since Philosopher’s Stone, LEGO unveiled Harry Potter The Ministry of Magic – Collectors’ Edition (76476): a 3,491-piece cross-section with street-level phone booth, Umbridge and Arthur Weasley offices, courtroom, Hall of Prophecy, 14 minifigures, and Kingsley Shacklebolt’s Lynx Patronus. Insiders early access began Aug. 29; general release Sept. 1 at $449.99, with a phone-booth GWP for early Insiders buyers. It joins September’s busy adult-display wave already stocking shelves.

4a611b3dc409220367939deceb936c36d1a00b4d.headline: Trumbull Restaurant Week returns Oct. 2–9 with 20 local eateries
4a611b3dc409220367939deceb936c36d1a00b4d.summary: Trumbull Restaurant Week runs October 2–9, inviting residents to support local restaurants with specials across roughly 20 participating spots, from Prime One Eleven and Izumi Sushi to Ecco Wine Bar, Fryborg, and Trumbull Pizza Company. Town officials call it a chance to back the business community while sampling limited-time menus. Full participant details are listed on the Trumbull Restaurant Week site and the town’s Patch wrap.

1fdd6bf5619daee1291fd6aef483ddbd79f84b0d.headline: White House pushes faster DHS review of 47 state voter rolls for noncitizens
1fdd6bf5619daee1291fd6aef483ddbd79f84b0d.summary: An internal DHS email seen by Reuters shows the White House pressing agencies to accelerate checks of at least 47 state voter rolls under an Unlawful Voter Initiative ahead of the midterms. Hundreds of officers have been surged, and rolls are being “enriched” with commercial Accurint data, raising false-positive risks for citizens. DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin said 1,620 cases are under investigation; Nevada previously saw a preliminary 16,000-name list shrink to 185 verified matches.

2a1285423ea9c694fe9ee61f885b448a0eb30b3c.headline: Trump admin releases CISA blueprint to harden 2026 election infrastructure
2a1285423ea9c694fe9ee61f885b448a0eb30b3c.summary: DHS and CISA released a 13-page 2026 Election Infrastructure Security Plan outlining cyber and physical threats and free tools for election officials, including risk assessments, vulnerability scanning, regional advisors, and fusion-center intelligence sharing. The plan encourages paper ballots and post-election manual audits. DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin framed election security as national security; the document marks a shift for an agency previously criticized for speech-policing roles.

db3da7db604398dee1e4ef7e7e605f7bddf7d534.headline: Apple confirms iPhone 18 Pro Face ID fix update coming early next week
db3da7db604398dee1e4ef7e7e605f7bddf7d534.summary: Apple confirmed to 9to5Mac that a software update early next week will address a Face ID bug affecting some iPhone 18 Pro users. The fix is expected to arrive as iOS 27.0.1, which Apple was already observed testing. The confirmation elevates yesterday’s build-watch into an official timeline for owners who have seen Face ID fail to unlock or authorize apps.

6ba1b826c21b6d4a952633be0715a3755412bc6a.headline: Qualcomm renews global patent licensing deal with Apple from April 2027
6ba1b826c21b6d4a952633be0715a3755412bc6a.summary: Qualcomm announced renewal of its global patent licensing agreement with Apple, effective April 1, 2027, without disclosing the new term length. The patent deal is separate from modem supply; Apple continues shifting to its own C2 modem, with only the U.S. iPhone 18 Pro Max still shipping a Qualcomm modem. The original post-settlement license began in 2019 and had been extended through March 2027.

29f7996dbea58880293d8af6d0c6b224d5966535.headline: Tesla Semi factory sneak peek: PepsiCo, DHL, US Foods trucks staged for tonight
29f7996dbea58880293d8af6d0c6b224d5966535.summary: Drone footage over Tesla’s new Nevada Semi plant shows at least 11 customer-branded Semis lined up ahead of tonight’s Rollout livestream (9 p.m. ET), including PepsiCo, US Foods, DHL, ArcBest/ABF, Einride, IMC, WattEV, and OK Produce. Familiar fleet names sit beside likely new order reveals. The dedicated factory, producing since April, is rated for 50,000 trucks a year; analysts still expect far fewer deliveries in 2026.

9e8fc7c2368b7b4b1f135101e81c7f93a756bb06.headline: Starship Flight 14 stacked at Starbase for first orbital attempt as early as Sep 28
9e8fc7c2368b7b4b1f135101e81c7f93a756bb06.summary: SpaceX stacked Ship 41 on Super Heavy booster B21 at Starbase, assembling the 124-meter stack for Flight 14 — Starship’s first full orbital attempt. A window opens 7:15 a.m. CDT September 28 pending an FAA flight license; a temporary flight restriction runs through October 7. The planned ~10-hour mission would carry Starlink V3 satellites and attempt a Pacific splashdown west of Chile after six orbits.

6aa6784d0af699f83877316fd0cbd04f21dec31a.headline: Penguins 2026-27 preview: Crosby-era core still the foundation as youth push
6aa6784d0af699f83877316fd0cbd04f21dec31a.summary: NHL.com’s season preview frames Pittsburgh’s challenge as balancing contention with development around Crosby, Malkin, Karlsson, and Letang after last year’s playoff return. Goaltending (Silovs projected to start; Murashov as the upside backup), Andrei Kuzmenko’s one-year deal, and Nicholas Robertson’s Crosby-line looks are key watch items. Rutger McGroarty, Ville Koivunen, and Harrison Brunicke remain the youth bets as the regular season opens September 29.

5dbd96610f50dfd5bdbb3ca9dfb353b0f54cf516.headline: Jets defense ranks No. 1 overall as Bailey and Thomas fuel Lions-week prep
5dbd96610f50dfd5bdbb3ca9dfb353b0f54cf516.summary: Through two games the Jets sit No. 1 in total defense (197 yards allowed per game), No. 2 against the pass and run, while preparing for Sunday’s trip to Detroit. Second-year CB Azareye’h Thomas owns the NFL’s longest active pass-defensed streak, and rookie edge David Bailey already has two sacks. Safeties Andre Cisco and Dane Belton have covered for injured Minkah Fitzpatrick as Aaron Glenn’s unit emphasizes attacking the ball.

ff5aa58ac261ea34085178deeeea916ef05dd6d1.headline: LEGO UCS Executor Super Star Destroyer: 6,130 pieces, $799.99, on sale Oct. 1
ff5aa58ac261ea34085178deeeea916ef05dd6d1.summary: The LEGO Group’s Ultimate Collector Series Executor Super Star Destroyer (75457) is the longest LEGO Star Wars model yet at 6,130 pieces and 53.5 inches, priced at $799.99 and available October 1. It includes Darth Vader plus all six bounty hunters in one set for the first time, a minifig-scale bridge scene, a companion Star Destroyer, and a built-in stand. Early buyers (Oct. 1–7) get a Gift with Purchase Darth Vader Lightsaber set while stocks last.

d10c02bded52579037a3d8899d82c05bc96c6a26.headline: Andrew Wilson drops Erika Kirk texts and video — Candace Owens still unconvinced
d10c02bded52579037a3d8899d82c05bc96c6a26.summary: Commentator Andrew Wilson released private texts attributed to Erika Kirk and a September 8, 2025 video of Charlie Kirk with his daughter watching the Bears, arguing the family was home that evening. Critics note Erika does not appear in the clip, and Candace Owens continues to challenge metadata and timing. The fresh drop keeps the anniversary-cycle dispute over Erika’s whereabouts alive without settling the underlying questions.

f76d129e90529fd69abc457a87862bb64316fed9.headline: Maine foliage report: northern color change high as nor’easter threatens weekend
f76d129e90529fd69abc457a87862bb64316fed9.summary: Maine’s Thursday foliage report shows high color change in the north, moderate in central Maine, and still-low color in the south, where peak usually arrives mid-to-late October. Drought is accelerating progression and may shorten the season, spokesperson Gale Ross warned, while urging leaf-peepers to watch a rare September nor’easter forecast for the weekend coast. Northern peak traditionally lands the last week of September through the first week of October.
